notes.title: Server improvements, voting system changes, updated OST, and QoL changes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We’re back after a few months of work on Ultimate Chicken Horse with version 1.10.06 on all platforms. 

We addressed several server issues that came up during the Shellebration Update, changed how voting works on community-made custom levels, and added a new song to the OST. Plus some other minor changes.

Read below for more, and join the Ultimate Chicken Horse Discord to keep up-to-date with all things Chicken and Horse!

Server refactor
After the Shellebration Update, we had more players online than ever before. (Wow, thank you!) However, our servers were not prepared for the sheer number of people enjoying the game. This resulted in players experiencing many server desync issues like endless loading screens, getting stuck in the party box, placed blocks not showing up, and lobbies randomly shutting down. 

We’ve just completed a server refactor to address these desync issues and prevent them from happening in the future. It also gives us the ability to add more servers to high traffic regions whenever we have a big influx of new players. :) 

We also addressed a country-wide connection issue for players in Korea. As of today, everyone in Korea should be able to connect and play online again! Thank you for your patience and bug reports - there were many Korean players who helped us solve the problem by sending us their player logs. ❤️

If you experience any server issues or bugs, please report them to the developers in the Ultimate Chicken Horse Discord. 

Downvotes removed from custom levels
We removed downvotes from the voting system for custom/community-made levels! 

Downvotes were not being used in a way that was useful or kind to our community, which warranted their removal. If you don’t enjoy a level, you now have the choice to upvote it or ignore it. (Note that you can still report levels that break our community rules!)

Ultimate Chicken Horse OST
The game’s soundtrack just got a new song! It now has the “Shellebration” track which plays during the Metro level.

Quality of life changes
We received feedback that the game's initial volume was too loud, so we reduced it by 20%. (Now the Horse noise is less of a jumpscare!) 

That’s all for now! We’ll be monitoring the server situation and keeping an eye out for any new issues. Have fun out there. 🙂

- Sincerely, Clever Endeavour

notes.title: Ultimate Chicken Horse patch 1.9.02
notes.notes:
Ultimate Chicken Horse version 1.9.02 is now Live!

Here's a reminder of what to expect:

Both of the services that the game uses for all of the online content and online multiplayer had to be replaced. The game should work exactly as it did before, but you may notice some strangeness in this transitional period:

 Extremely new content (levels, votes, challenge times) may be lost if they were posted between the last time we grabbed data and now. We'll work to retrieve that if we can. We should be able to at least retrieve the newest levels in the coming days.
 Many older uploaded levels will be missing. Due to technical constraints, we weren't able to migrate every single level that had ever been uploaded. We've managed to migrate over 200,000 levels that were either popular or created in the last year. You can use the "My Levels" filter to see which of your published levels made it over. If any of your levels seem to be missing but you still have a local copy saved, feel free to publish it again!
 Almost all of the data besides uploaded levels should be present and visible. This includes level statistics, high scores and your personal bests. Note that in places where a username is shown, if the associated user comes from data that was migrated the display name will be whatever it was at that time and may not update if that same user changes their display name in the future.


Patch Notes
Features:

 Added crossplay with Xbox. All platforms can now play together!
 Replaced the GameSparks server solution with BrainCloud, this now handles all player authentication, level uploads, level bans, challenge times, user bans, etc.
 Added "Tournament" as a preset. These rules were suggested to us by the community.
 Added new Farmhands, Syd (community manager) and SuperNimbus (team we worked with for server changes) to the credits


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed animal icons navigating inventory sometimes lose their costumes
 Characters dance sound continues when jumping directly from dance
 Lots of bug fixes involving the changes that were made to the servers

notes.title: Ultimate Chicken Horse Patch Notes V1.9.02
notes.notes:
Hello!

Our patch is coming out shortly (this Tuesday) and we have lots of info to throw your way! 

The patch’s purpose is to move servers and tweak some bugs. However, we're also not solidly sure what issues may appear while the levels are porting from new users from one server to the next, so we would advise the following during this transition period of 48 hours:

- Don’t make any new levels during this transition period!

- Don’t try to beat any high scores!

- Don’t upvote/downvote anything!

In short: save your creativity/speedruns for two days later! 

Now, for the GOOD stuff:

- Did someone ask for Xbox cross-play? Well, we heard you! Everyone is now able to play with everyone! But…

- It should be known that Xbox Gamertags are displayed as anonymous in leaderboards and results screens, this is normal and expected. This is due to Xbox’s legal standards and set-up, not something on our end.

- As a tiny gift to our lovely community, we’ve added a tournament rules preset — [details here]. If you have any concerns/questions about the rules, that’s something to chat about with the community as they were created upon request :)

- We’ve updated the credits! Thanks to everyone who has helped us since our last edit of them.

- Because of all of the changes to the back-end, there have been some wonky things about challenge scores, users, etc. Please report anything you see!

- There is a possibility that we might lose the ability to click on a player's score on a level in order to open up their profile on Steam.

Thanks for your patience, enthusiasm and coolness!

Best,

Clever Endeavour

notes.title: Hippo-Party-Plus Update is OUT NOW! Patch Notes V1.8.22
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2pTnfNFk2CY;full][/previewyoutube]

The Hippo-Party Plus Update is OUT NOW!!

For more details on the update, check out our website: https://www.cleverendeavourgames.com/hippo-update

Ultimate Chicken Horse V1.8.22 - 2021-09-20
The Hippo-Party-Plus update includes:

- 1 new character: Hippopotamus
- 1 new alternative skin: Triceratops
- 4 new outfits: Floatie (Hippo), Cowboy Boots (Hippo), Balloon (Hippo) Jockey Outfit (Horse)
- 1 new level: Rollercoaster

Minor Features
- Ultimate Chicken Horse has been updated to Unity 2020 - some beta testers have reported a smoother, more optimized feel to the game
- Added a Help and Tips section to the pause menu
- Adjusted some physics for better wall experiences
- Players can no longer spam the pause button, which previously let players exploit level timers and some physics
- Added some new backgrounds for community-level creations
- Players can now delete custom levels that they have uploaded
- Level Fullness is always displayed in freeplay build mode
Bug Fixes
- Adjusted some physics for better wall experiences (smoother motion on wall slides and less likely to “bounce” off walls)
- Fixing these physics problems has had a cascading effect that we believe improves the feel of the game, and makes it slightly more responsive. It does slightly change the fundamental physics of the game, and some previous advanced techniques will have to be rediscovered or adjusted.
- “Follow player” camera fixed after respawns and in Sudden Death
- Punching Flowers punch in the correct direction on flipped treadmills
- Run Time Limit properly ends rounds when players have multiple respawns remaining
- Zombies are able to pick up coins
- Parkour preset properly applies block probabilities and removes trap blocks
- Fixed cursor regions when using controllers on ultra-wide monitors
- Added collision areas to Ballroom to prevent spawn kills from placing blocks too close
- Bees give trap points
- Fixed various issues with Bees respawning
- Bees now deactivate when player dies and turns into a Zombie
- More consistent platforms in Treehouse
- Fixed some localizations so they properly appear in UI
- Fixed various other localization mistakes
- Zombies should no longer lock up games in certain scenarios
- Twitch chat no longer overrides block probability settings
- Fixed small issues with animal artwork.
- Challengeboard scoreboard no longer briefly shows the world record message from a previous attempt
- Fixed non-slippery ice when you crouch immediately while landing
- Fixed Jetpack sound sometimes never ending in the inventory

Changes

- Sudden death will always have a timer
- No longer able to wall jump off ceiling
- Made animal dead colliders more consistent with each other.
- Scaffolding now has a consistent rotation speed when attached to rotating blocks for all orientations
- Picked up coins won't slow rotating platforms as you move away from the platform with the coin
- Upblowers are no longer able to blow through the moving platforms that they are attached to
- Slightly increased Canon level fullness cost

notes.title: Announcing the Hippo-Party-Plus Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2pTnfNFk2CY;full][/previewyoutube]

A new character joins the animal party! Meet Hippo in this FREE content update for Ultimate Chicken Horse, coming to you on September 20, 2021 on all supported platforms!

The Hippo-Party-Plus update includes:


 1 new character: Hippopotamus
 1 new alternative skin: Triceratops
 4 new outfits: Floatie (Hippo), Cowboy Boots (Hippo), Balloon (Hippo) Jockey Outfit (Horse)
 1 new level: Rollercoaster
 Tons of bug fixes

As with previous updates, you’ll be able to unlock the new character, reskin, outfits and level by collecting unlock boxes on all levels with a ? sign. No purchase necessary.

New Character: Hippopotamus

Large and in-charge, Hippopotamus (Hippo for short) joins the Ultimate Chicken Horse cast!

This groovy critter is ready to boogie the house down! Don’t let the goofy smile fool you, Hippo is a real contender for the Ultimate title.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/e91863724694faf59e6a329075ac94e3175ca92d.gif

Alternative Skin: Triceratops

Head all the way back to the Cretaceous period with Hippo’s alternative skin, Triceratops!

This alternative Hippo skin is compatible with all of the regular Hippo accessories. How did Triceratops safely join the rest of the animals? No one really knows, but we heard it had something to do with a very special car...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/7dcd945e05a568979ee9ec83e39025d428d7d752.png

New Outfits

Once you’ve become acquainted with Hippo, you’ll be able to unlock these nifty accessories for Hippo and Triceratops:

Cowboy boots: While Hippo usually has dancing shoes on, sometimes they get swapped out for these trusty boots.
Balloon: Picked up from the fairground, its name is Wilson.
Floatie: Hippo can’t swim, so they need this device when they go to the pool with the other animals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/ac2ed68961a1f6828b3a2d89be5d7db3165d91f5.png

Despite being in the game title, Horse has always been one accessory short, compared to the other critters. But fear not, we bought Horse a new outfit! 

Horse loved it so much we made sure to provide 7 different colour variations: blue, orange, green, purple, red, pink and yellow. While Horse is convinced the outfit is streamlined for speed, it doesn’t do much other than look cool. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/e56f15d1388bfb56ac0ed766f4343b227705ef11.png

New Level: Rollercoaster
The whole cast and crew have ventured off to the local theme park and a certain attraction has caught their eye: this speeding roller coaster!

Once unlocked, this map will have players placing blocks and traps that allow them to safely pass under the tracks and on to the finish line on another piece of totally safety-compliant scaffolding.
 
Make sure to keep your appendages away from the ride at all times; it will send you right to the grave if you get too close!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/d8cfd570e52801ab6c9d560650219a1aa0f4eb06.png

Other Changes

For a full list of changes and bug fixes, click here: https://www.cleverendeavourgames.com/hippo-update

A Note About Future Updates

First off, thank you to everyone who has played Ultimate Chicken Horse over the past 5+ years. This game is what it is today thanks to your love and support, and we’re so incredibly grateful that we’ve been able to support it for so many years!

This update took so much longer to come out versus our initial prediction, and we want to share some context as to why. Last year we discovered that the online architecture we use was going to be retired in the next few years so we started looking for alternatives. We have every intention of keeping Ultimate Chicken Horse functional for as long as we can. Unfortunately, what seemed like a simple thing to change ended up being… not so simple at all. The solutions we found weren’t compatible with the Unity version we have used since the game’s conception and upgrading it to the 2020 version caused a bunch of plugins to break, new issues cropped up on various platforms and so much more. This work already would have taken much longer than expected and it was just made significantly worse with COVID. The original work we had set out to do was taking so much longer than planned, that we made the decision to release new content now rather than wait for the more technical backend architecture to be completed.

This update was also undertaken in tandem with our new project at Clever Endeavour Games - something we’re extremely excited to be working on! If we were a larger studio, we could probably continue to update Ultimate Chicken Horse while working on a new IP. The reality is that we’re only 6 people and this update has already significantly impacted the development of our new title. (If you want to stay up to date with our latest title, sign up for our newsletter.)

While we are not saying there won’t ever be new content for Ultimate Chicken Horse, this is the last content update that we have planned for the foreseeable future. We know this will be sad or disappointing for some - there are so many great ideas for new characters, levels, modes and so much more. For us, too, it feels a bit scary as we move into new territory.

To be clear, this does not mean we’re completely shutting down the game. We just spent so much time and energy on making sure this game lasts for as long as it can!! We’re still going to finish the online architecture update, continue featuring levels on LevelNET, host events on Discord, and answer support tickets. As long as there’s a community to support it and we’re able to, we want to keep this party going. So keep sending us your Ultimate Chicken Horse fan art, ideas, and concepts - it keeps us inspired for the future!

Thank you all, once again, and we hope you’ll stick around for our next adventure together.

<3
The Clever Endeavour Team

notes.title: Online Update, A New Block, & Official Soundtrack Release!
notes.notes:
It's the Steam Summer Sale!!!

With it, Ultimate Chicken Horse has gotten some major online updates: there's no more "Beta branch" for online play, we've improved connectivity, added clearer messaging, and generally improved the whole online experience to make it much more playable. We are still keeping the online mode labeled as "Beta" because we will be constantly updating it, improving it and fixing the remaining bugs. You can check the full Update Log for a full list of improvements.

In this update, we're also including a bit of a preview for new content to come! We've added a new block, the horizontal moving block, which should open up a whole new world of possibilities of movement, placement and screwing with your friends:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10073974/5fad978933cb4ffc3d60ee2c00d989b268a8b8a0.gif

We're planning on rolling out more content once the online Beta is out of Beta, but we wanted to give you a quick tease. 

Last but certainly not least, we're announcing the official UCH soundtrack with a great new bundle!

 https://richard-atlas.squarespace.com/s/2016-06-20-SoundtrackAnnounce.png

The soundtrack was made by the amazingly talented Vibe Avenue, contains 12 tracks and over 40 minutes of sweet tunes. It also features live instruments: trumpets, saxophones, flutes, whistles, banjos, guitars, harmonica and more!

https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/t/576abb55d1758e130b9a8710/1466612573448/?format=500w

Enjoy, and you can expect some more big updates coming soon!

notes.title: Online Beta Update - Easier To Connect With Friends!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since our last announcement, where we mentioned that the online beta would be coming soon. Well, we've got good news for you! It's actually been out for a little while, but previously people had been having issues connecting and had been experiencing game-breaking bugs. This announcement brings some important changes :)

https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/t/5702b7d437013bada73c4eb7/1459795925285/016_Multiplayer2.PNG

Online Improvements

No more need for port forwarding
Scoring system works properly and games end at the right time
For a full list of fixes, check out the Steam discussion here


There are definitely still bugs though, which is why it's still in Beta. If you're experiencing bugs that aren't on the known list, please submit them here.

Known Issues

No sudden death when there's a tie game
Two coins can't be picked up at the same time online
For the full list of known issues, check out the Steam discussion here.


Next Steps?

We're working on making sure that the online play is seamless and there are no game-breaking bugs, so that's the highest priority. We've also started looking into setting up server lists so that you can join a game online without needing to have friends! I mean... without needing to invite friends to play online. This will act as a sort of "matchmaking", and we may look into doing real matchmaking at some point, but that will come later. 

For now, enjoy the game, and if you want updates, be sure to follow us on Twitter. Thank you!
